# Abstract

In the HELIOS dataset, treatment reduced error by 12.4% (95% CI 8.1–16.7%).
The intervention did not improve retention under low-light conditions.

## Methods

We trained ResNet-50 with AdamW for 40 epochs using a learning rate of 0.0003.
All experiments used three random seeds and a batch size of 64.

### Limitations

Results may not generalize beyond the HELIOS dataset or the tested conditions.
